technical-summary: Three new MCP tools for the ledger commit workflow: (1) get_pending_events(group_by) reads current ledger NDJSON, filters status=unreleased, and groups via union-find clustering — group_by="plan-items" clusters events sharing plan-item-ids transitively, "files" clusters by file overlap, "flat" returns raw list. Single events with no overlap land in ungrouped. (2) record_change_event now accepts dict | list[dict] — dispatches to record_changes for lists. (3) get_fragment(event_id) looks up a single event by ID, raises CON-LEDGER-001 if not found. Added error-resolutions.yaml for agent-ledger component with CON-LEDGER-001 code.
user-summary-candidate: Ledger MCP: get_pending_events groups pending events for commit decisions; batch record_change_event; get_fragment lookup.

technical-summary: Reorganized 42 Python files from flat services/ directory into 8 subdirectories by functional domain: config/ (provider configuration & features), catalog/ (model catalogs & projections), execution/ (runtime execution & prompt ops), lifecycle/ (install, health, status), capabilities/ (provider capability families & handlers), mcp/ (MCP server management), session/ (session surface resolution), host/ (host adapter & probe). Moved support/ grab-bag files to their proper domains. Secrets.py and reconcile.py remain at root as cross-cutting modules. Converted all internal imports to relative paths; external imports use new absolute dotted paths.
user-summary-candidate: Restructured providers/services into subdirectories by functional domain (config, catalog, execution, lifecycle, capabilities, mcp, session, host) — 42 files moved with all imports updated and verified.

technical-summary: Fixed schema-path off-by-one bugs left by the concurrent services-package reorg (flat services/*.py modules moved into services/{capabilities,config,catalog,...}/ subpackages). Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] pointed one level too shallow after the extra directory nesting, causing FileNotFoundError on provider-recipe.schema.json, model-sources.schema.json, model-source-catalog.schema.json, and provider-plugin-entry-payload.schema.json. Changed to parents[2] in each. Not part of the capability-model work; fixed because they blocked verifying the PC provider-capability-model reduction against a clean baseline.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed schema-path resolution bugs introduced by the provider services package reorganization.

technical-summary: Completed the provider-capability-model clean-cut (PC01-PC04). All 16 provider descriptors rewritten from the four legacy blocks (automation_capabilities, capability_facts, config-spec fields, host_capabilities/permissions) to the unified capabilities: map. Retired the legacy shape entirely: removed 9 dead builder functions, deleted the transitional _capabilities_from_values bridge, removed the PROVIDER_SPEC registrations for all retired top-level keys, and added a generic unknown-top-level-key rejection to DescriptorSpec.load() (VAL-DESC-004) so any leftover legacy key fails loudly instead of being silently dropped. Merged _families.yaml into _capabilities.yaml; deleted the standalone file. Fixed several real catalogue bugs surfaced during migration (surface-skill wrongly callable-ref, lsp-config/lsp-self-support sharing one ambiguous mechanism_schema, model-catalog-refresh wrongly attached to model-projection family, missing ownership_scope_required/family_id on several kinds). Verified: full provider + coding_lsp suites green with zero regressions beyond 9 pre-existing failures confirmed to belong to unrelated concurrent workstreams (harness-extraction, execution-package split, model-availability feature). Remaining PC scope (bare-noun kind rename, managed-reconcile schema consolidation, models/launch capability merges, obs-* neutralization, taxonomy doc regeneration) is explicitly deferred and documented on PC04, not lost.
user-summary-candidate: Completed the provider capability model migration: all 16 providers now declare a single unified capabilities map, and the old scattered descriptor shape is fully retired with no legacy fallback left behind.

technical-summary: Bare-noun kind rename (deferred PC01 scope, now done): mcp-config->mcp, hook-config->hooks, model-config->model-endpoints, plugin-config->plugins, perm-declaration->permissions, host-extension->host-extensions, file-agent->agent-files, surface-render->surfaces (absorbing the old legacy 'surfaces' alias entry, which was deleted as a now-literal duplicate). Deleted 3 confirmed-dead catalogue kinds: exec-adapter and depr-status (retired per PC01 -- execution/deprecated are orthogonal fields, never declared as capabilities by any of the 16 providers), and lsp-mcp-receive (dead field, zero consumers). Updated base.py's 13 accessor properties to the new ids. Bulk-renamed the capabilities: keys across all 16 provider YAMLs via sed, verified no old ids remain anywhere in src/tests (excluding two confirmed-unrelated string collisions: a Pi CLI flag literal and a status-report dict key). Self-review performed before considering the stage complete: catalogue has zero orphaned family_id/canonical_kind references, zero unknown kind refs in any of the 16 providers, and every one of the 13 accessor properties resolves without error across all 16 descriptors (131 total capabilities). Verified: full provider + coding_lsp suites green, identical 9 pre-existing out-of-lane failures, zero new regressions.
user-summary-candidate: Renamed the provider capability catalogue's kind ids to clean bare nouns (mcp, hooks, plugins, permissions, etc.) and removed 3 dead catalogue entries, with a full consistency review before marking the stage done.

technical-summary: Models merge (deferred PC01 scope, now done): folded model-endpoints + model-catalog-refresh + model-connectors + model-credentials + the top-level vendor_key_injection/model_entry_renderer fields into ONE `models` capability with a compound mechanism (new ModelsSpec dataclass: store/entry_renderer/refresh/connectors/credentials). Unified credential references onto the existing secrets.py canonical scheme:locator grammar (e.g. 'env:OPENAI_API_KEY') instead of the bespoke {mechanism,key} dict -- discovered providers_api.py was already hand-reconstructing this exact string via f'env:{key_name}' right before calling secrets.py's has_ambient_value, confirming the duplication. Credential refs are validated via secrets.py's own parse_secret_ref at descriptor-load time. Updated 2 real consumer sites in providers_api.py to use the canonical string directly (removed the reconstruction). automation_capabilities synthesis fixed to gate model-projection family registration on `store` presence specifically -- catalogue review caught that merging operational model-catalog-refresh into the always-provisioned models kind would have wrongly made claude/local-openai/openhands/cline/qwen register for model dispatch despite having no store to reconcile (verified via before/after family-list diff across all 7 affected providers). Restored a genuine bug found during migration: opencode.yaml's top-level model_entry_renderer had been silently dropped (present in an earlier snapshot, absent now) -- confirmed the target function still exists and re-wired it into the merged capability. Renamed the config_surfaces API output label model-endpoints->models for consistency (left the unrelated managed-model-endpoints.json on-disk registry filename untouched). Full review before completing: catalogue has no orphaned family refs, zero stray old kind-id/top-level-key references anywhere in src/tests, all accessors resolve clean across all 16 providers. Suite green, same 9 pre-existing out-of-lane failures.
user-summary-candidate: Unified all model-related provider capabilities (endpoints, catalog refresh, connectors, credentials) into one `models` capability, and put credential references on the same canonical format the codebase's secrets-management code already uses.
